title: Machine-readable CLI output the web can consume
probes: One Task, two repos, one branch, one PR per repo (ADR 0015/0017), with a data contract that has to agree across both.
description:
As someone scripting the todo list I want structured output so that I do not have to parse the human-readable lines.

- Add `--json` to `todo list` in the CLI, emitting the filtered todos as a JSON array with no decorative text.
- The web repo currently reads the todo file directly. Give it a documented shape for a todo and have both repos agree on it, so a field added in one is not silently missing in the other.

The human-readable output must be unchanged when `--json` is absent.
